provenance: Maintainer-authored source-first rubric, 2026-09-08. Read all hunks of the four primary files and referenced runtime declarations at both exact tags; no generated event answers existed. Requires independent semantic adjudication; not a claim of independently validated gold or release-wide completeness.
scope: Selected whole-file deltas at 143.0.7499.194 -> 147.0.7727.139. Core memberships below are disjoint scoring anchors, not an exhaustive list of supporting findings. Alternate defensible narrative boundaries require semantic adjudication, not keyword matching.

events.required_meaning: Group tool declarations, tool-call/tool-response message types, call identity/arguments, structured success/error responses and conditional structured outputs into a tool-calling contract. Source typedefs and streaming comments add evidence beyond extracted finding rows.
events.conditions: Secure context and declared Window/Worker runtime exposure; structured output comments require tool declarations and expectedOutputs tool-call. Windows AIPromptAPI is experimental in the supplied runtime declaration, not proof of shipped product rollout.
events.action: Check callers that assume prompt returns only a string and streaming yields only text; verify tool request/result handling and applicable runtime exposure.

events.required_meaning: New context-named usage/window/overflow API coexists with legacy input/quota names now gated by LanguageModelLegacyParamsAndAttributes. Old measurement and usage attributes are marked deprecated. Do not claim the old declarations are absent.
events.conditions: New and old endpoints establish a net migration, not intermediate history. The measurement comment has a direction inconsistent with the declaration delta; base the bounded conclusion on both declarations and note the inconsistency when relevant.
events.action: Locate consumers of legacy measurement, quota and overflow names; adapt and verify behaviour under the actual legacy gate.

events.required_meaning: Sampling options, accessors and params acquire the legacy runtime gate across creation and instance/static APIs. This is not merely an unrelated list of IDL member changes. A larger coherent legacy migration event can receive semantic credit if both distinct consequences are explained.
events.conditions: Comments describe non-extension deprecation; the public runtime feature declaration alone does not establish actual per-context enablement.
events.action: Audit consumers that configure or read these legacy sampling parameters; establish extension/runtime conditions before claiming breakage.

events.required_meaning: Clipboard change notification changes from no parameters to carrying types and a change_id; explain the consumer contract together.
events.conditions: An IPC signature delta is not proof of a stock-browser or website regression. Out-of-tree implementations and mixed-version peers need separate evidence.
events.action: Inspect implementations/callers of ClipboardListener and adapt payload handling where applicable.

events.required_meaning: Both stable extensible media-state enums annotate kUnknown as Default. This is an explicit default/compatibility declaration change, not a new camera or microphone user capability. Explain the unrelated blank-line hunk as non-behavioural.
events.conditions: Specific decoder fallback consequences need generator/consumer evidence; do not invent a rollout or user-visible state change from these declarations alone.
events.action: Check generated bindings and compatibility assumptions if consuming these extensible states outside the matching upstream build.

negative_controls: Do not infer rollout, historical split/revert/merge or product-specific breakage from endpoint declarations alone.
Do not merge tool calling and clipboard notifications because both are contracts.
